NodeScope is an unofficial, read-only companion app for CoreScope, the mesh network analyzer used by MeshTexas and other MeshCore communities. It talks directly to a CoreScope server\'s public API to show the same live nodes, packet traffic, channel messages, and observer data you\'d see on the CoreScope web dashboard — just in a native app.
